description.narrative: El objetivo principal del PROARES III es reducir la vulnerabilidad y el riesgo social de individuos y familias en los municipios ms pobres de Cear, a travs de su inclusin en servicios sociales diferenciados y de promocin del empleo. Para ello, el programa desarrollar e implementar acciones para promover el acceso, mejorar la infraestructura y la calidad de los servicios sociales y de inclusin productiva, respectivamente de nios, jvenes en riesgo, familias pobres y vulnerables, y trabajadores informales.

The main objective of PROARES III is to reduce vulnerability and social risk of individuals and families living in the poorest municipalities in Ceara, through their inclusion in differentiated social services and through employment. To do this, the program will develop and implement actions to promote access, improve infrastructure and quality of social services and productive inclusion, respectively for children, youth at risk, poor and vulnerable families and informal workers
